name: nats-replica
description: A cold replica of a nats-primary on another node: NATS 2.14.10 by digest, JetStream on a data volume at /data, every message fsynced, a domain named after the service, and one leaf node remote that dials the primary's leaf port as the user leaf. It starts once the owner sets NATS_LEAF_REMOTE (the primary's ADDRESS:PORT, which kernel.serviceDestinations names for it) and NATS_LEAF_PASSWORD (the primary's). Its streams are mirrors made with the nats CLI. A link gives NATS_URL.
